subject: CCTV Footage — Lobby Camera (21:30–22:00)
body:
Detective,

I've flagged the key segment from the lobby camera. The footage shows Dr. Rask entering at approximately 21:40. Of note: a second individual enters approximately 2 minutes and 35 seconds later, partially obscured.

I've bookmarked the relevant timestamp. Open the attachment to jump directly to that moment in the CCTV Viewer.

— Officer Reyes
